note: No daily-report, schedule-wiring, or GPS-specific logic detected in this file. 'calibrations' refers to PDF scale calibration (point1/point2 rulers), not GPS. Offline mutations are routed through @/lib/offline/mutation-client. Presence/online-users tracking is included.

events.capability: initial-hook: annotations CRUD, pay-items state, calibration storage (PDF scale), local-storage persistence, project create/load
events.anchor: createProject / addAnnotation / removeAnnotation / updateAnnotation / setCalibration / updatePayItems / persist

events.capability: clear local-storage state on load (start clean, no stale project auto-restore)
reset payItems + activePayItemId on project clear
undo/redo stack (add/remove annotation history) + copyCalibrationToPages (bulk calibration propagation)
guard payItems local-storage load behind active-project check
always clear active project on mount (PDF can't survive page refresh)
removeAnnotationsForPayItem – cascade-delete annotations when a pay item is removed
Supabase cloud persistence: async upsert/insert/delete for annotations, calibrations, pay-items; UseProjectOptions(supabaseProjectId, userId); dbSync guard; initProject replaces createProject
real-time sync: Supabase postgres_changes subscription on annotations table (INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE from other users)
annotation override fields: manualQuantity, location, notes (mapped to DB columns manual_quantity / location / notes)
events.anchor: record.manual_quantity / record.location / record.notes in realtime handler

events.capability: debounced updated_at timestamp sync to projects table on annotation change (5 s debounce)
undo/redo counter state (undoCount/redoCount) for reactive canUndo/canRedo
manual annotation support: dedup guard in real-time INSERT handler (prevent race-condition duplicates)
presence/online-users tracking: Supabase Presence channel per project, exposes onlineUsers[]
mobile UX demo tweak (minor param/return adjustment)
offline mutations: all annotation writes (add/remove/update/bulk-remove) routed through offlineMutate (@/lib/offline/mutation-client) for offline-first queue support
undo/redo remote sync via offlineMutate: reinsertAnnotation + deleteAnnotationRemote helpers used in undo/redo paths so remote state tracks local history
events.anchor: reinsertAnnotation / deleteAnnotationRemote / undo / redo (async offlineMutate calls)

pivots.what: Architecture pivot: local-storage-only hook → cloud-first hook. Introduced UseProjectOptions(supabaseProjectId, userId), replaced createProject with initProject accepting existing DB rows, all mutations became async with Supabase upsert paths behind dbSync() guard.
Persistence pivot: direct Supabase writes → offline-first queue. All annotation mutations wrapped in offlineMutate, enabling operation queueing when network is unavailable.

capabilityAbsent: GPS calibration storage (calibrations here are PDF-scale rulers, not GPS coordinates)
